en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 19.1.
Kusala-ttika (The Triplet of the Wholesome)
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
19.1.1–2. Section on Dependence, etc.
Cause and Object.
Dependent on an unwholesome state, an unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates [arise] … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].

Dependent on an unwholesome state, an indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate … [dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise].

Dependent on [one] aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise … pe … Dependent on a non-wholesome state, both unwholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a non-unwholesome state, a wholesome state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-unwholesome state … [and so forth].

Dependent on an indeterminate state, an indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a non-unwholesome state, wholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root-condition … three [combinations].
Dependent on a non-indeterminate state, an indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a non-indeterminate state… [text continues]
Dependent on [a] wholesome state, a wholesome state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an indeterminate state, an unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate state, both wholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate state, both unwholesome and indeterminate states [arise by way of root condition].
They arise by way of root condition... five.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate, an unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate, an indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. Neither unwholesome nor...
Dependent on an indeterminate state, unwholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate, a wholesome state arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate, an indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. Neither unwholesome nor…
Dependent on an indeterminate state, wholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root condition... three.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, an indeterminate state arises by way of root condition...
one. Dependent on a wholesome state, an unwholesome state arises by way of object condition. Dependent on a wholesome state, an indeterminate state arises by way of object condition... two.
Dependent on a non-unwholesome state, a wholesome state arises by way of object condition. Dependent on a non-unwholesome state, an indeterminate state arises by way of object condition … two.
Dependent on an indeterminate state, a wholesome state arises by way of object condition. Dependent on an indeterminate state, an unwholesome state arises by way of object condition … two.
Dependent on both a wholesome and an indeterminate state, an unwholesome state arises by way of object condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate, a wholesome state arises by way of object-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, an indeterminate state arises by way of object-condition … one. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are eighteen; under object-condition, nine; under predominance-condition, eighteen … pe … under result-condition, three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, eighteen.
Negative:
Dependent on a non-root, non-object, non-wholesome state, a non-wholesome state arises by way of the non-root condition. Dependent on a non-wholesome state...

Dependent on [a state], an indeterminate state arises by way of the not-root condition …pe… dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, an indeterminate state arises by way of the not-root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, an indeterminate state arises by way of the not-object condition …pe… dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, an indeterminate state arises by way of the not-object condition. (Abbreviated.)

With not-root condition, six; with not-object condition, six; with not-predominance condition, eighteen … pe … with not-prenascence condition, twelve … pe … with not-kamma condition, nine … pe … with not-nutriment, not-faculty, not-jhāna, and not-path conditions, three … pe … with not-dissociation condition, nine … pe … with not-disappearance condition, six.
With root condition, not-object condition, six … (Abbreviated.
With not-root condition, object condition, six … (Abbreviated.)
(The Chapter on Co-nascence is similar to the Chapter on Dependence.
19.1.3–6. The Chapters on Conditions, etc.
Conditioned by a non-wholesome state, a wholesome state arises by way of root-condition. Conditioned by a non-wholesome state...
Conditioned by an unwholesome state, an unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Conditioned by an unwholesome state, an indeterminate state arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by an unwholesome state, both wholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root condition.
Conditioned by an unwholesome state, both unwholesome and indeterminate states arise by way of root condition.
By way of root condition … five.
Conditioned by a non-unwholesome state, a non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition … five.
Conditioned by an indeterminate state, an indeterminate state arises by way of root condition … five.
Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate... three.

Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor indeterminate... three. Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, a wholesome state arises by way of root condition... five. (Abbreviated. In the case of roots, there are twenty-six;
in the case of objects, thirteen... pe... in the case of resultants, three... pe... in the case of non-disappearance, twenty-six.
In the section on association, there are nine [answers] for root-cause ... pe ... nine for non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.
The section on association is similar to the section on dependence.
19.1.7. The Question Section.
An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of root-condition. An unwholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of root-condition.
An unwholesome state is a condition for both an unwholesome and an indeterminate state by way of root-condition. ... [Three] sets.
A non-wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of root-condition … three.
A non-indeterminate state is a condition for a non-indeterminate state by way of root-condition … five.
Both non-wholesome and non-indeterminate states are conditions for a non-wholesome state by way of root-condition … three.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to a wholesome state by way of root condition … three.
States that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome are related to an indeterminate state by way of root condition … one. Object-condition (ārammaṇa-paccaya).
A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of object-condition … three.
An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of object-condition … three.
A neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome state is a condition for a neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome state by way of object-condition … three.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to a wholesome state by way of object condition.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to an unwholesome state by way of object condition.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to an indeterminate state by way of object condition... [three].
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to a wholesome state by way of object-condition.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to an unwholesome state by way of object-condition.
States that are neither wholesome nor indeterminate are related to an indeterminate state by way of object-condition. ... [Three.]
States that are both unwholesome and neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome are related to a wholesome state by way of object-condition … three. (Abbreviated. In the case of root-cause, eighteen;
in the case of object, eighteen; in the case of predominance, twenty-three; in the case of proximity, sixteen … pe … in the case of conascence, eighteen;
in the case of mutuality, nine; in the case of support, twenty-two; in the case of decisive support, eighteen; in the case of prenascence, nine; in the case of postnascence … [and so on].
Six in repetition; nine in cultivation; eighteen in kamma; three in result; [and so on] ... eighteen in the path; nine in association;
twelve in dissociation; ... twenty-two in non-disappearance. (The "Chapter of Questions" should be expanded in detail.)
